Read to claim the Limited Portrait and Growth Materials.[/p][p]\[Main Rewards]: [/p][p]2-Year Anniversary Limited Dynamic Portrait - \[Recorded Melody of Rain], Growth Materials[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/92480c03f360a4da169a9b73280f254b9cf86c66.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Second Turn[/p][p]Timekeeper's Annual Report[/p][p]\[Eligibility]: [/p][p]Player Level ≥5[/p][p]\[Duration]: [/p][p]2025-09-19 08:30 - 2025-10-30 04:59 (UTC-5)[/p][p]\[Event Intro]: [/p][p]View the annual report and relevant data to earn Clear Drop x100 and Growth Materials.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/c852346702d5a4bc7b971e550c97f1bafc434fce.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A Long Way from Home[/p][p]\[Eligibility]: [/p][p]Complete the main story 1ST-01 \[Wretched Brats][/p][p]\[Duration]: [/p][p]2025-10-01 05:00 - 2025-10-15 04:59 (UTC-5)[/p][p]\[Event Intro]: [/p][p]During the event, sign in for a certain number of days to get the limited Building, Clear Drops, Jar of Picrasma Candy, and Growth Materials.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/a2b9ace547f4e2944d49329944fe5ab44165d8b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"Double Once Only" Bonuses Are Back![/p][p]\[Reactivation Time]: [/p][p]After the version update on 2025-09-19 (UTC-5)[/p][p]\[Details]:[/p][p]※Enjoy the bonuses for your first purchase of Crystal Drop pack at each price level.[/p][p]※The bonuses won't stack with any previous ones, that is: you can only enjoy the "Double Once Only" Bonuses ONCE for each Crystal Drop pack in the new version, even if you haven't enjoyed these bonuses before the Reactivation Time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/012fe5866829e522e5f04ad5d7224472de44583b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Anniversary Exclusive Pack[/p][p]\[Pack Name]: Souvenir of Companionship[/p][p]\[Duration]: After the version update on 2025-09-19 - 2025-10-30 04:59 (UTC-5)[/p][p]\[Price]: $29.99[/p][p]\[Contents]: [/p][p]Unilog x10, Friendship in Suitcase x1 (Invite one of the designated 6-star characters to your suitcase. Expires at 2025-10-30 04:59 (UTC-5).)[/p][p]\[Friendship in Suitcase] Designated 6-Star Characters: [/p][p]All 6-star characters available in \[Amongst the Lake] up to Version 2.8.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/56dbf6f2c37530069337644ff669cdac3bbcbcc1.png"][/img][/p][p]Paradise Regained[/p][p]New Main Story Chapter[/p][p]\[Chapter 10: Paradise Regained][/p][p]The ship of fate has arrived at the world's southernmost point, and pieces, both black and white, have begun to cross the board in search of the truth. Now, it all lies before her.[/p][p]In the uncharted expanse, make your search for the faintest glimmer of hope.[/p][p]\[Main Rewards]: [/p][p]Clear Drops, Growth Materials[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/9e68fe70199a04a7951407dac5b4efcaaf44cc6f.png"][/img][/p][p]Moldir: A Moment on the White Expanse[/p][p]Character Story[/p][p]\[Eligibility]: [/p][p]Complete the main story 1ST-16 \[Heaven Apostles][/p][p]\[Duration]: [/p][p]2025-10-09 05:00 - 2025-10-30 04:59 (UTC-5)[/p][p]\[Event Intro]: [/p][p]A path, a memory, a conviction—and all she leaves unspoken—are buried deep beneath the ice, crystallized into a single snowflake.[/p][p]Across the vast Antarctic expanse, deploy scouting teams to make surveys.[/p][p]\[Main Rewards]: [/p][p]Clear Drops, Growth Materials[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/12bf23074deec741e0f1fdf50d92ab7e528926d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Pre-Storm Protocol[/p][p]Survival & Exploration Gameplay[/p][p]\[Eligibility]:[/p][p]Complete the main story 3RD-15 \[The Other Future][/p][p]\[Duration]: [/p][p]After the version update on 2025-09-19 - 2025-10-30 04:59 (UTC-5)[/p][p]\[Event Intro]:[/p][p]You will play the role of Ulrich and use Musae III's simulation device to initiate an experiment for LSCC—to find the optimal balance between scientific progress and personnel safety before the "Storm" hits.​[/p][p]Form a trusted team to enter the simulation environment for exploration, with assistants providing their unique abilities to aid the mission.[/p][p]Once inside, you must gather resources before the time runs out and evacuate safely. Otherwise, you'll be contaminated with Storm Syndrome. The field exercise fails when all team members' resistance reaches zero.[/p][p]During the exploration, you'll encounter various events and challenges. Complete them to obtain supplies or new assistants.[/p][p]Collected supplies can upgrade building levels, equip gadgets, and strengthen your team.[/p][p]Under the effect of the simulated "Storm," enemies will attack safe zones. You need strategic team composition to repel them. Deploying suitable assistants can weaken enemies for easier combat.[/p][p]Complete field exercises to accumulate performance evaluations and earn corresponding rewards.[/p][p]The fragments collected during exploration can activate the mind circuit system, forming complete logic chains that provide permanent buffs and effects to facilitate future exploration.[/p][p]\[Main Rewards]: [/p][p]6-Star Psychube \[A Tingle of a Thought], Limited Portrait \[The Art of Management], New Incantation Flair \[Wanderer's Guide][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/0ec5e7264203c9ddf12779935da23f7dea414f85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Critter Crash[/p][p]Strategic Team-Building Mode[/p][p]\[Eligibility]: [/p][p]Complete the main story 1ST-16 \[Heaven Apostles][/p][p]\[Duration]: [/p][p]2025-09-25 05:00 - notes.title: 2.2 Devs Broadcast
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/6be3a9e64ad01ad5ecff5b9b7323c69c01e0ec08.jpg[/img]

Dear Timekeeper,

Over the past year, we've experienced Version 1.4 Mystery Box Carnival, Version 1.6 Half-Anniversary Celebration, and Version 1.9 First Anniversary Celebration. We hope the game has brought you many unforgettable moments through the journey. Reflecting on 2024, we wouldn't be where we are today without the devotion and support of each and every Timekeeper. In the upcoming Version 2.2, we're introducing the beginning of the Main Story in the 2.0 series, Chapter 8: Tristes Tropiques, as well as a new Mystery Box Carnival!

Our journey now takes us to São Paulo, where the stationed Zeno forces, a mysterious writer, and a "familiar face" who vanished in the "Storm" await ... As tensions reignite, perhaps it's time to reevaluate the allegiances you've held until now.

In addition to the new storyline, we've prepared brand-new permanent contents on a major scale, various feature optimizations, and loads of rewards for the celebration. We'll be hosting a special preview livestream for the Mystery Box Carnival on January 3rd, and we can't wait to see you there!

Before the celebration officially begins, here's a peek at some of the new and optimized contents in this version:

1: Favorite Character Marking
In the 2.2 update, we'll add a Favorite Character Marking feature on the character details page. You can mark characters according to your preferences, and whether sorting them by Level, Rarity, or Bond, or just under normal conditions, your marked characters will be displayed first for easier access.

2: Garment Special Effects Preview
The Garment Special Effects Preview feature will be introduced in Version 2.2. Even if you don't own a character or garment, you can preview new arcane skill animations and new entry actions of the newly added or returning garments in the character Garment interface, the [Garment Shop] in Bank, or via in-game announcements.

We'll be adding previews for some existing garments in later versions.

3: Time-Limited Mane's Bulletin Event
In anticipation of the celebration, Version 2.2 [Mane's Bulletin] will feature a special time-limited event again. We'll continue adjusting the rules for boss challenges in [Breaking Catastrophe] while introducing new [Bounty's Spur] rewards for certain characters to add more variety to the gameplay.

4: Optional Download for Reflections Events
After the Version 2.2 update, past recurring events will become available for optional download to help reduce the game's base download size. Players who wish to experience these events can easily download them directly from the Reflections interface.

For more updates on this new version, please stay tuned for our preview livestream and subsequent official announcements.

We remain committed to providing you with the best possible content in each version and a constantly improving gaming experience. Once again, thank you for your support—for this edition of the 1999 Devs Broadcast, we'd like to present you with an exclusive gift:

Gift Details: 
Clear Drop x120 and Jar of Picrasma Candy x1

Claim Period:
The gift has already been sent via Mail. Please remember to claim it in time.
